script.description: Script of every sanskrit string. English is English.

ref.description: Numbering as the source uses it; unique within the file

kind.description: Form of the text; group = several verses the source joins

scope.description: What `sanskrit` and `english` both hold. text = an independent work (prakarana, kavya, itihasa); mula = verse/sutra only; commentary = commentary or intro prose only; mula+commentary = both

sanskrit.description: Eval input. Null = no input, unit is skipped

english.description: Reference translation of exactly `sanskrit` (same scope). Null = unit is skipped

parts.description: Optional metadata, never scored: the pieces of a commentary unit. A part with sanskrit but no english, or a part outside `scope`, is allowed

meta.description: Source-specific extras (alignment method, edit logs, verbatim English)

alignment.description: How english relates to sanskrit per unit. row_aligned: source pairs them. by_ref: same ref scheme in two editions, not verified. unaligned: english has no per-unit split yet.

reference_type.description: translation: english translates the sanskrit; interpretive: translator's reading or expansion of it; summary: english summarises it

english_rights.description: rights status of the english sources used in the file; check before redistribution

quality.description: Optional. noisy_alignment: row-aligned sentence-aligner output where about half the rows carry a phrase from a neighbouring row; fine for coarse comparison, not an exact reference. unproofread_ocr: the sanskrit is raw OCR.
